summary: Open QuarterMaster is a self-hosted inventory management system designed to track stock levels and assets. It provides a structured way to organise items across locations using scalable data models. The project is distributed under the GPL-3.0 licence and receives frequent development activity.
goodFor: It suits teams or individuals who need a dedicated, source-available system to manage internal stock without relying on proprietary cloud services.
watchOut: With a relatively small community following and niche adoption, you may encounter fewer community-written guides or third-party integrations compared to more mainstream alternatives.
deployNotes: Deployment is typically straightforward using Docker containers or deb packages. You will usually need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place the service behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
